title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description: King Arthur (Graham Chapman) goes questing on a pretend horse, followed by his lackey clacking coconut shells.

title: King Kong Lives
description: The big ape receives a heart transplant and runs off with his blood donor, a she-ape having his baby.

title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
description: Three investigators (Jean Reno, Benoît Magimel, Camille Natta) track a cloaked killer who possesses superhuman strength and speed.

title: Misbehaviour
description: A team of women hatches a plan to disrupt the 1970 Miss World beauty competition in London.

title: Castle Falls
description: A hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished, but no one knows that a gang leader hid $3 million in stolen cash inside. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

title: Valentine: The Dark Avenger
description: A chance meeting with a film director leads to a waitress turned actress's transformation into a consummate superhero.

title: Midnight Sun
description: A teen who lives with a life-threatening sensitivity to sunlight finds romance with a young man she's admired for years. As their relationship starts to blossom, she desperately tries to hide her condition from her unsuspecting new beau.

title: Justin Bieber's Believe
description: Pop superstar Justin Bieber talks about his music, relationships and growing up in the spotlight. Concert footage, behind-the-scenes access, and appearances by Usher, Ludacris and other performers augment Bieber's narrative.

title: City Hunter
description: U.S. criminals hijack a cruise ship with a gluttonous private eye (Jackie Chan) aboard who is seeking a magnate's missing daughter.

title: Swords of Vengeance
description: Loyal vassals and samurai join forces to avenge the unjust execution of a lord in Japan.

title: The Man With the Golden Arm
description: A dried-out heroin addict (Frank Sinatra) returns to his wife (Eleanor Parker) and card dealing in Chicago.

title: Infernal Affairs II
description: In this prequel to the original, a rebel policeman sets up the infiltration of Triad gangs and tries to bring down a corrupt cop working for the Triad boss.

title: Class of 1984
description: A high-school music teacher (Perry King) hunts a hoodlum student (Timothy Van Patten) for attacking his wife (Merrie Lynn Ross).

title: Rosewater
description: While covering an election protest in 2009 Iran, BBC journalist Maziar Bahari is arrested, imprisoned and tortured for nearly four months.

title: Marlowe
description: Detective Philip Marlowe becomes embroiled in an investigation with a wealthy family in Bay City, Calif., after a beautiful blonde hires him to find her former lover.

title: The Bat
description: A mystery writer (Agnes Moorehead) and her friends are stalked by a faceless throat-ripper (Vincent Price) in a haunted house.

title: Insomnia
description: A yuppie (Cristina Marcos) befriends a real estate agent (Ernesto Alterio) engaged to a woman who shops compulsively.

title: A Tale of Two Guns
description: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

title: Living in Oblivion
description: A harried director must contend with technical foul-ups and actors' shenanigans on the set of a low-budget film.

title: Sharktopus vs. Whalewolf
description: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a hybrid of a killer whale and a wolf.

title: The Big Sleep
description: Private eye Philip Marlowe falls into a porno/blackmail/murder case in the 1970s London.

title: Capricorn One
description: The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.

title: Language Lessons
description: When Adam's husband surprises him with weekly Spanish lessons, he's unsure about where or how this new element will fit into his already structured life. However, when tragedy strikes, his teacher becomes a lifeline he didn't know he needed.

title: The Gunman
description: A former Special Forces soldier (Sean Penn) who has PTSD tries to reconnect with his longtime lover, but must first find out who wants him dead... and why.

title: Journey to the End of the Night
description: A man (Brendan Fraser) hatches a scheme to double-cross his father (Scott Glenn) and steal money from a drug deal.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Man of the Year
description: Tom Dobbs (Robin Williams), the satirical host of a political talk show, runs for U.S. president and unexpectedly wins.

title: Donnie Darko: The Director's Cut
description: An unusual teenager (Jake Gyllenhaal) follows the instructions of the 6-foot-tall rabbit which saved his life.

title: Whale Rider
description: A Maori girl (Keisha Castle-Hughes) defies her grandfather (Rawiri Paratene) and 1,000 years of tradition to prove she can lead their tribe.

title: Take Me to the River
description: Music legends from Stax Records and Memphis mentor and pass on their musical knowledge to contemporary artists.

title: Magic
description: A neurotic ventriloquist's belief that his stage dummy controls his actions leads him to murder, madness and more.

title: The Gunman
description: A former Special Forces soldier (Sean Penn) who has PTSD tries to reconnect with his longtime lover, but must first find out who wants him dead... and why.

title: House
description: In an effort to avoid spending time with her father and his creepy new lover, young Gorgeous (Kimiko Ikegami) resolves to visit her aunt's remote mansion, where supernatural events occur almost immediately.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Kingslayer
description: Soon to be crowned king of England, Richard the Lionheart has an attempted courtship turn quickly into a race for survival. Ambushed during a romantic encounter, Richard and his stable maid Lea fight for their lives.

title: Homeboy
description: A low-life boxer (Mickey Rourke) hits town for a fight and meets a two-bit hood (Christopher Walken) who tries to lure him into a robbery.

title: Slacker
description: Filmmaker Richard Linklater uses a string of mostly amateur actors to show varieties of a type: the new bohemian.

title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
description: In the 19th century, a buxom woman (Cassandra Peterson) of mystery and shtick visits a castle inhabited by a fatally cursed family.

title: Fist of Legend
description: A Chinese martial arts student leads his classmates in revolt against Japanese invaders who killed their instructor.

title: The Gambler II
description:
S01 E01 — The Adventure Continues
Brady Hawkes, Billy Montana and Jeremiah Hawkes are on a train bound for a huge gambling event when the train is taken over by a gang of vicious killers in search of money.
